description: React renders state into UI and reconciles the DOM. Routing, data loading, rendering location and project structure are left to you or to a framework.
The set of decisions that affect the whole application and are expensive to reverse: rendering model, code organization, data ownership and how teams and deploys scale.
1. where and when it renders, 2. how code is organized, 3. how state and data are managed, 4. how it scales across teams and deploys. Each layer is decided independently.
Decisions inside a component or a small family (props, composition, local state). Cheap to change, limited blast radius.
A choice made by a template, a default or a habit without anyone naming it, such as client-side rendering from a starter template.
